changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO REFDATA.PROMOTION_STATE (NAME, DISPLAY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, USER_ID, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ('PROMOTED', 'Promoted', 'New VID passes hard gates and beats current best on soft metrics', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('KEPT', 'Kept', 'Current best retains IS_BEST_IND (new VID did not beat it)', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('DEMOTED', 'Demoted', 'Current best failed hard gates and lost IS_BEST_IND', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('REJECTED', 'Rejected', 'Candidate failed hard gates (not the current best)', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');
